Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).

Please find 3 packages below. Each of them works for us; let us know which one suits you best.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have noted your internal cost calculations and delivery metrics.

Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot comprises a price of €33.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

We are prepared to accept the increased volume of 23,400 units and a 24-month contract, but we must maintain the lead time at 54 days to ensure reliable supply. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
